stages.name: syntax_rows
stages.query: SELECT x.__path,x.__start,x.__end,x.kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (4) THEN '' ELSE x.text END AS text,x.line,x.parent_start,x.parent_end,x.parent_kind,x.ancestor_start,x.ancestor_end,x.ancestor_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.name_start END AS name_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.name_source END AS name_source,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.left_start END AS left_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.left_end END AS left_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.left_kind END AS left_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.right_start END AS right_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.right_end END AS right_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.right_kind END AS right_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.right_source END AS right_source,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.type_start END AS type_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.type_end END AS type_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.type_kind END AS type_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (1,3) THEN x.function_start END AS function_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (1,3) THEN x.function_end END AS function_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (1,3) THEN x.function_kind END AS function_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (2,3) THEN x.object_start END AS object_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (2,3) THEN x.object_end END AS object_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (2,3) THEN x.object_kind END AS object_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (2,3) THEN x.object_source END AS object_source,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (2,3) THEN x.attribute_start END AS attribute_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (2,3) THEN x.attribute_source END AS attribute_source,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.body_start END AS body_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.body_end END AS body_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.body_kind END AS body_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.parameters_start END AS parameters_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.parameters_end END AS parameters_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.parameters_kind END AS parameters_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.condition_start END AS condition_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.condition_end END AS condition_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.condition_kind END AS condition_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.subject_start END AS subject_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.subject_end END AS subject_end,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3,4) THEN x.subject_kind END AS subject_kind,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3) THEN x.alias_source END AS alias_source,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3) THEN x.module_name_start END AS module_name_start,CASE WHEN x.grp IN (3) THEN x.module_name_source END AS module_name_source FROM (SELECT n.__path,n.__start,n.__end,n.kind,n.text,n.line,n.parent_start,n.parent_end,n.parent_kind,s.ancestor_start AS ancestor_start,s.ancestor_end AS ancestor_end,s.ancestor_kind AS ancestor_kind,n.name_start,n.name_source,n.left_start,n.left_end,n.left_kind,n.right_start,n.right_end,n.right_kind,n.right_source,n.type_start,n.type_end,n.type_kind,n.function_start,n.function_end,n.function_kind,n.object_start,n.object_end,n.object_kind,n.object_source,n.attribute_start,n.attribute_source,n.body_start,n.body_end,n.body_kind,n.parameters_start,n.parameters_end,n.parameters_kind,n.condition_start,n.condition_end,n.condition_kind,n.subject_start,n.subject_end,n.subject_kind,n.alias_source,n.module_name_start,n.module_name_source,CASE WHEN n.kind IN ('identifier','concatenated_string','string') THEN 0 WHEN n.kind IN ('call') THEN 1 WHEN n.kind IN ('attribute') THEN 2 WHEN n.kind IN ('argument_list','assignment','augmented_assignment','block','case_clause','class_definition','decorated_definition','elif_clause','else_clause','expression_statement','for_statement','function_definition','if_statement','keyword_argument','match_statement','module','return_statement') THEN 4 ELSE 3 END AS grp FROM sel_qc s JOIN py_nodes n ON n.__path=s.__path AND n.__start=s.__start AND n.__end=s.__end AND n.kind=s.kind) x

stages.name: node_ordinals
stages.query: SELECT __path,__start,__end,kind,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal FROM syntax_rows

stages.name: nodes
stages.query:
SELECT n.*,n.kind||':'||n.__start||':'||n.__end AS id,
 n.parent_kind||':'||n.parent_start||':'||n.parent_end AS parent,
 n.ancestor_kind||':'||n.ancestor_start||':'||n.ancestor_end AS edge_parent,o.ordinal
 FROM syntax_rows n JOIN node_ordinals o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.__start=n.__start AND o.__end=n.__end AND o.kind=n.kind

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,edge_parent AS src,id AS dst,ordinal FROM nodes WHERE edge_parent IS NOT NULL

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition'

stages.name: ownership
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,id,fn,cls,top_fn) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='class_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END FROM nodes n
 LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.edge_parent WHERE parent.id IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT child.__path,child.id,CASE WHEN child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.fn END,CASE WHEN child.kind='class_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.cls END,CASE WHEN owned.top_fn IS NULL AND child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.top_fn END
 FROM owned JOIN edges e ON e.__path=owned.__path AND e.src=owned.id
 JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=e.__path AND child.id=e.dst) SELECT * FROM owned

stages.name: classes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='class_definition'

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_kind||':'||n.object_start||':'||n.object_end AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute'

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_kind||':'||n.function_start||':'||n.function_end LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call'

stages.name: descendant_roots
stages.query: SELECT __path,id FROM (WITH RECURSIVE roots(__path,id) AS (SELECT __path,id FROM nodes WHERE kind='type' OR kind='assignment' AND type_start IS NOT NULL OR kind='function_definition' AND (name_source='require_sql_physical_conditional' OR name_source='compile_sql_conditional_step' OR name_source='compile' AND rx_matches(__path,'(?:^|/)l2070_batching/conditional_step\.py$')) UNION SELECT __path,left_kind||':'||left_start||':'||left_end FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('assignment','for_statement') UNION SELECT __path,condition_kind||':'||condition_start||':'||condition_end FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('if_statement','elif_clause') UNION SELECT __path,subject_kind||':'||subject_start||':'||subject_end FROM nodes WHERE kind='match_statement' UNION SELECT child.__path,child.id FROM nodes parent JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=parent.__path AND child.parent=parent.id AND child.ordinal=1 WHERE parent.kind='conditional_expression') SELECT __path,id FROM roots) WHERE __path IS NOT NULL AND id IS NOT NULL

reachability.edges: WITH RECURSIVE demanded(__path,id) AS (SELECT __path,id FROM descendant_roots UNION SELECT d.__path,e.dst FROM demanded d CROSS JOIN edges e ON e.__path=d.__path AND e.src=d.id) SELECT e.__path,e.src,e.dst FROM demanded d CROSS JOIN edges e ON e.__path=d.__path AND e.src=d.id

stages.name: returns
stages.query: SELECT n.*,v.id AS value,v.kind AS expr_kind,v.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='return_statement'

stages.name: assignments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,l.id AS target,l.kind AS target_kind,l.text AS target_text,r.id AS value,r.kind AS expr_kind,r.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end LEFT JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.right_kind||':'||n.right_start||':'||n.right_end LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind IN ('assignment','augmented_assignment')

stages.name: parameters
stages.query:
SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,p.id,p.kind,p.text,n.text AS name,p.type_kind||':'||p.type_start||':'||p.type_end AS annotation,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.id ORDER BY p.__start)-1 AS position FROM functions f JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=f.__path AND p.parent=f.parameters_kind||':'||f.parameters_start||':'||f.parameters_end JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND (n.id=p.id AND p.kind='identifier' OR n.parent=p.id AND n.ordinal=0 AND n.kind='identifier')
 WHERE p.kind IN ('identifier','typed_parameter','default_parameter','typed_default_parameter')

stages.name: module_names
stages.query: SELECT __path,replace(rx_extract(__path,'(?:^|/)((?:impl|l2070_batching|scripts)/.*)\.py$',1),'/','.') AS qualified FROM nodes WHERE kind='module' AND rx_matches(__path,'(?:^|/)(?:impl|l2070_batching|scripts)/') UNION SELECT __path,rx_extract(__path,'(?:^|/)([^/]+)\.py$',1) FROM nodes WHERE kind='module' AND NOT rx_matches(__path,'(?:^|/)(?:impl|l2070_batching|scripts)/')

stages.name: aliases
stages.query: SELECT n.__path,n.__start,CASE WHEN n.kind='aliased_import' THEN n.alias_source WHEN parent.kind='import_statement' THEN rx_extract(n.text,'^([\w]+)',1) ELSE n.text END AS local,CASE WHEN parent.kind='import_from_statement' THEN trim(parent.module_name_source,'.')||'.'||CASE WHEN n.kind='aliased_import' THEN n.name_source ELSE n.text END ELSE CASE WHEN n.kind='aliased_import' THEN n.name_source ELSE n.text END END AS origin FROM nodes n JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.parent WHERE parent.kind IN ('import_statement','import_from_statement') AND n.kind IN ('dotted_name','aliased_import') AND n.__start!=coalesce(parent.module_name_start,-1)

stages.name: conditional_classes
stages.query: WITH latest AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT __path,name,max(__start) AS __start FROM classes GROUP BY __path,name) SELECT c.*,module.qualified||'.'||c.name AS qualified_name,1 AS chosen FROM latest w JOIN classes c ON c.__path=w.__path AND c.name=w.name AND c.__start=w.__start JOIN module_names module ON module.__path=c.__path

stages.name: class_bases
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS cls,coalesce((SELECT alias.origin FROM aliases alias WHERE alias.__path=c.__path AND alias.local=rx_extract(b.text,'^([\w]+)',1) AND alias.__start<c.__start ORDER BY alias.__start DESC LIMIT 1),rx_extract(b.text,'^([\w]+)',1))||coalesce(rx_extract(b.text,'^[\w]+((?:\.[\w]+)*)',1),'') AS name FROM conditional_classes c JOIN nodes arg ON arg.__path=c.__path AND arg.parent=c.id AND arg.kind='argument_list' JOIN nodes b ON b.__path=arg.__path AND b.parent=arg.id WHERE b.kind IN ('identifier','attribute','call')

stages.name: derived_conditionals
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE derived(name) AS (SELECT 'l2070_batching.conditional_step.ConditionalStep' UNION SELECT c.qualified_name FROM conditional_classes c JOIN class_bases b ON b.__path=c.__path AND b.cls=c.id JOIN derived d ON d.name=b.name) SELECT * FROM derived

stages.name: conditional_methods
stages.query: WITH latest AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT f.__path,own.cls,f.name,max(f.__start) AS __start FROM functions f JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=f.__path AND own.id=f.id JOIN conditional_classes c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.id=own.cls GROUP BY f.__path,own.cls,f.name) SELECT f.*,c.id AS cls,c.name AS class_name,c.qualified_name,1 AS chosen FROM latest w JOIN functions f ON f.__path=w.__path AND f.name=w.name AND f.__start=w.__start JOIN conditional_classes c ON c.__path=w.__path AND c.id=w.cls

stages.name: conditional_functions
stages.query: WITH latest AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT f.__path,f.name,max(f.__start) AS __start FROM functions f JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=f.__path AND own.id=f.id WHERE own.cls IS NULL GROUP BY f.__path,f.name) SELECT f.*,module.qualified||'.'||f.name AS qualified_name,1 AS chosen FROM latest w JOIN functions f ON f.__path=w.__path AND f.name=w.name AND f.__start=w.__start JOIN module_names module ON module.__path=f.__path

stages.name: function_colors
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN nodes a ON a.__path=d.__path AND a.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id AND a.kind='identifier' AND a.text='BackendType') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=d.__path AND a.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id AND a.attr IN ('backend_type','is_sql_backend','dialect')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN nodes branch ON branch.__path=d.__path AND branch.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id AND branch.kind IN ('if_statement','elif_clause','conditional_expression','match_statement')) AS backend_selection,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN nodes raised ON raised.__path=d.__path AND raised.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id AND raised.kind='raise_statement' AND rx_matches(raised.text,'^raise\s+TypeError(?:\s*\(|\s*$)')) AS raises_type_error FROM functions f WHERE f.name='require_sql_physical_conditional' OR f.name='compile_sql_conditional_step' OR f.name='compile' AND rx_matches(f.__path,'(?:^|/)l2070_batching/conditional_step\.py$')

stages.name: contract_blocks
stages.query: SELECT n.*,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY n.__path ORDER BY n.__end-n.__start,n.__start) AS sequence FROM nodes n JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=n.__path AND own.id=n.id JOIN conditional_methods m ON m.__path=own.__path AND m.id=own.fn WHERE n.kind='block' AND m.name='require_sql_physical_conditional'

stages.name: callable_names
stages.query: SELECT n.* FROM nodes n LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND n.text='Callable' AND NOT (parent.kind='attribute' AND parent.attribute_start=n.__start) AND NOT (parent.kind IN ('keyword_argument','function_definition','class_definition') AND parent.name_start=n.__start) AND parent.kind NOT IN ('parameters','lambda_parameters','list_splat_pattern','dictionary_splat_pattern')

stages.name: callable_parameters
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT p.__path,p.fn,p.name FROM parameters p JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=p.__path AND d.root=p.annotation JOIN callable_names atom ON atom.__path=d.__path AND atom.id=d.node

stages.name: block_results
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE fold(__path,sequence,state) AS (SELECT DISTINCT __path,0,'{}' FROM contract_blocks UNION ALL SELECT b.__path,b.sequence,substr(fold.state,1,length(fold.state)-1)||CASE WHEN length(fold.state)>2 THEN ',' ELSE '' END||json_quote(b.id)||':'||CAST((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes stmt WHERE stmt.__path=b.__path AND stmt.parent=b.id AND stmt.__start<=coalesce((SELECT min(barrier.__start) FROM nodes barrier WHERE barrier.__path=b.__path AND barrier.parent=b.id AND barrier.kind IN ('raise_statement','return_statement')),b.__end) AND (stmt.kind='raise_statement' AND rx_matches(stmt.text,'^raise\s+TypeError(?:\s*\(|\s*$)') OR stmt.kind='if_statement' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes alternative WHERE alternative.__path=stmt.__path AND alternative.parent=stmt.id AND alternative.kind='else_clause') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contract_blocks child WHERE child.__path=stmt.__path AND (child.parent=stmt.id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes arm WHERE arm.__path=child.__path AND arm.id=child.parent AND arm.parent=stmt.id AND arm.kind IN ('elif_clause','else_clause'))) AND coalesce(json_extract(fold.state,'$."'||child.id||'"'),0)!=1) OR stmt.kind='match_statement' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes arm WHERE arm.__path=stmt.__path AND arm.kind='case_clause' AND arm.__start>stmt.__start AND arm.__end<=stmt.__end) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contract_blocks child JOIN nodes arm ON arm.__path=child.__path AND arm.id=child.parent AND arm.kind='case_clause' WHERE arm.__path=stmt.__path AND arm.__start>stmt.__start AND arm.__end<=stmt.__end AND coalesce(json_extract(fold.state,'$."'||child.id||'"'),0)!=1)))) AS TEXT)||'}' FROM fold JOIN contract_blocks b ON b.__path=fold.__path AND b.sequence=fold.sequence+1) SELECT __path,state FROM fold WHERE sequence=(SELECT max(b.sequence) FROM contract_blocks b WHERE b.__path=fold.__path)

stages.name: always_raises
stages.query: SELECT m.__path,m.id FROM conditional_methods m JOIN block_results b ON b.__path=m.__path WHERE m.name='require_sql_physical_conditional' AND json_extract(b.state,'$."'||m.body_kind||':'||m.body_start||':'||m.body_end||'"')=1

stages.name: integer_returns
stages.query: SELECT m.__path,m.cls,m.name,n.kind,n.text,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY m.__path,m.cls,m.name ORDER BY n.__start) AS ordinal FROM conditional_methods m JOIN returns r ON r.__path=m.__path AND r.__start>=m.__start AND r.__start<=m.__end AND r.__end<=m.__end JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=r.__path AND n.id=r.value AND n.kind IN ('integer','true','false')

stages.name: branch_variables
stages.query: SELECT a.__path,m.id AS fn,name.text AS name,a.__start FROM conditional_methods m JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=m.__path AND a.__start>=m.__start AND a.__end<=m.__end JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=a.__path AND d.root=a.target JOIN nodes name ON name.__path=d.__path AND name.id=d.node AND name.kind='identifier' WHERE rx_matches(a.expr_text,'then_plan\.steps|else_plan\.steps|conditional_branch_steps|then_steps|else_steps') AND a.expr_kind IN ('identifier','attribute','call') UNION SELECT n.__path,m.id,name.text,n.__start FROM conditional_methods m JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=m.__path AND n.kind='for_statement' AND n.__start>=m.__start AND n.__end<=m.__end JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=n.__path AND d.root=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end JOIN nodes name ON name.__path=d.__path AND name.id=d.node AND name.kind='identifier' WHERE rx_matches(n.right_source,'then_plan\.steps|else_plan\.steps|conditional_branch_steps|then_steps|else_steps')

stages.name: self_stores
stages.query: SELECT a.*,attr.attr,m.cls,m.name AS method,m.id AS method_id,1 AS occurrence FROM assignments a JOIN attributes attr ON attr.__path=a.__path AND attr.id=a.target AND attr.object_text='self' JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=a.__path AND own.id=a.id JOIN conditional_methods m ON m.__path=own.__path AND m.id=own.fn

stages.name: conditional_findings_0
stages.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-029' AS issue,n.id AS identity,'semantic-compile' AS detector FROM conditional_classes n  WHERE n.qualified_name='l2070_batching.conditional_step.ConditionalStep' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM conditional_methods method WHERE method.__path=n.__path AND method.cls=n.id AND method.name='compile' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM function_colors color WHERE color.__path=method.__path AND color.id=method.id AND color.raises_type_error))) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-029' AS issue,n.id AS identity,'semantic-level' AS detector FROM conditional_classes n  WHERE n.qualified_name='l2070_batching.conditional_step.ConditionalStep' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM integer_returns r WHERE r.__path=n.__path AND r.cls=n.id AND r.name='level') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM integer_returns r WHERE r.__path=n.__path AND r.cls=n.id AND r.name='level' AND (r.kind='false' OR r.kind='integer' AND CAST(r.text AS INTEGER)<=0))) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-029' AS issue,n.id AS identity,'executor-hook' AS detector FROM conditional_classes n  WHERE n.qualified_name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.sql_backend_executor.SqlBackendExecutor' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM conditional_methods method WHERE method.__path=n.__path AND method.cls=n.id AND method.name='_lower_conditional_step' AND (1)) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-029' AS issue,n.id AS identity,'physical-level' AS detector FROM conditional_classes n  WHERE n.qualified_name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.sql_conditional.SqlConditionalStep' AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM integer_returns r WHERE r.__path=n.__path AND r.cls=n.id AND r.name='level')!=1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM integer_returns r WHERE r.__path=n.__path AND r.cls=n.id AND r.name='level' AND (r.kind='false' OR r.kind='integer' AND CAST(r.text AS INTEGER)=0))) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-029' AS issue,n.id AS identity,'physical-role' AS detector FROM conditional_classes n  WHERE n.qualified_name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.sql_conditional.SqlConditionalStep' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM conditional_methods method WHERE method.__path=n.__path AND method.cls=n.id AND method.name='execution_role' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM returns r WHERE r.__path=method.__path AND r.__start>=method.__start AND r.__end<=method.__end AND r.expr_text='StepExecutionRole.SQL'))) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-029' AS issue,n.id AS identity,'physical-compile' AS detector FROM conditional_classes n  WHERE n.qualified_name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.sql_conditional.SqlConditionalStep' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM conditional_methods method WHERE method.__path=n.__path AND method.cls=n.id AND method.name='compile' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls call WHERE call.__path=method.__path AND call.__start>=method.__start AND call.__end<=method.__end AND (rx_matches(call.full_callee,'compile_sql_conditional_step$'))))) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-029' AS issue,n.id||':'||n.occurrence AS identity,'runtime-state' AS detector FROM self_stores n  WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM conditional_classes cls JOIN derived_conditionals d ON d.name=cls.qualified_name WHERE cls.__path=n.__path AND cls.id=n.cls) AND n.method!='__init__' UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-029' AS issue,n.id||':'||n.occurrence AS identity,'runtime-callback' AS detector FROM self_stores n  WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM conditional_classes cls JOIN derived_conditionals d ON d.name=cls.qualified_name WHERE cls.__path=n.__path AND cls.id=n.cls) AND n.method='__init__' AND (n.expr_kind='lambda' OR n.expr_kind='identifier' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM callable_parameters p WHERE p.__path=n.__path AND p.fn=n.method_id AND p.name=n.expr_text)) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-029' AS issue,n.id||':'||atom.id AS identity,'declared-callback' AS detector FROM assignments n JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=n.__path AND own.id=n.id JOIN conditional_classes cls ON cls.__path=n.__path AND cls.id=own.cls JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=n.__path AND d.root=n.id JOIN callable_names atom ON atom.__path=d.__path AND atom.id=d.node WHERE n.fn IS NULL AND n.type_start IS NOT NULL AND cls.qualified_name IN (SELECT name FROM derived_conditionals) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-029' AS issue,n.id AS identity,'child-compilation' AS detector FROM calls n JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=n.__path AND own.id=n.id JOIN conditional_methods method ON method.__path=own.__path AND method.id=own.fn JOIN conditional_classes cls ON cls.__path=method.__path AND cls.id=method.cls WHERE n.callee='compile' AND cls.qualified_name IN (SELECT name FROM derived_conditionals) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attributes a JOIN branch_variables b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.fn=own.fn AND b.name=a.object_text AND b.__start<n.__start WHERE a.__path=n.__path AND a.id=n.callee_id) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-029' AS issue,method.id||':'||n.line AS identity,'backend-control' AS detector FROM nodes n JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=n.__path AND own.id=n.id JOIN conditional_methods method ON method.__path=own.__path AND method.id=own.fn JOIN conditional_classes cls ON cls.__path=method.__path AND
